Prepare sea cost transition matrix

bdy_get_cost_raster.Rd

Produces the transition matrix and cost raster used to calculate shortest path distances for birds with marine-exclusive lifestyles.

Usage

bdy_get_cost_raster(
  colonies,
  shapeBuffer = 100,
  pixel_size = 1000,
  N_buffer = 100,
  S_buffer = 100,
  W_buffer = 100,
  E_buffer = 100,
  returnRaster = F,
  plotOutput = F
)

Arguments

colonies

vector of geometries, giving the coordinates of bird colonies, wind farms, or others. This is used to get the extent of the raster to calculate.

shapeBuffer

Buffer size (in km) to map countries shorelines (parameter 'buffer' in bdy_prepare_countryShape())

pixel_size

numeric, size in meter of the cells represented by one pixel of the raster. Lower numbers give higher resolution, but greatly increase computing time.

N_buffer

north buffer to increase the extent of the raster beyond the northernmost colony or windfarm (numeric, in kilometers)

S_buffer

south buffer to increase the extent of the raster beyond the southernmost colony or windfarm (numeric, in kilometers)

W_buffer

west buffer to increase the extent of the raster beyond the westernmost colony or windfarm (numeric, in kilometers)

E_buffer

east buffer to increase the extent of the raster beyond the easternmost colony or windfarm (numeric, in kilometers)

returnRaster

binary parameter specifying whether the cost raster should be outputted or not

plotOutput

binary parameter specifying whether the cost raster should be plotted or not

Value

List of 2 elements:

  • 'transition_matrix': transitionLayer object where sea is represented as low cost and land is represented as high cost

  • 'cost_raster': raster object where sea is represented as low cost and land is represented as high cost
